For LinkageError, linkage failures (e.g., malformed class file) can occur unpredictably, and no validation prevents it. For ExceptionInInitializerError, initialization may fail (e.g., static initializer throws exception), and no validation prevents it. All three conditions are possible given the code context.
answer: ClassNotFoundException: condition not avoided (no check for class existence). LinkageError: condition not avoided (no validation to prevent linkage failure). ExceptionInInitializerError: condition not avoided (no prevention of initialization failure).
remark: ClassNotFoundException may occur if the constructed class name (e.g., 'mage.game.command.planes.SomePlane') does not correspond to a class on the classpath. LinkageError may occur if the class file is malformed, incompatible, or has a missing dependency.
